scenes.say: This car will replace the current one in IndyCar. It has already run on the Indianapolis oval. What's new?
The engine grows from two point two to two point four litres. Twin turbos, up to seven hundred and sixty horsepower.
The hybrid now uses a battery, a first for the series. It stores fourteen times more energy than the supercapacitor.
On September ninth, Alexander Rossi was first to drive it on the oval. The next day, Alex Palou took over.
IndyCar says the car can beat Indianapolis records from nineteen ninety-six. In September they weren't chasing them: speeds were kept moderate.
In October Palou ran forty-three laps at Sebring, a durability test. Racing with it starts in twenty twenty-eight.
Follow IndyCar on the LapRadar live map.

title: IR-28: IndyCar's new car has already run on the Indianapolis oval
